steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: New Classes
steps.body:
Class books are available here at the Training Hall — more unlock as you open new regions. Assign a book to one of your heroes to teach them a new fighting style.

Upgrade the hall and your heroes train harder — better equipment means a sharper edge on every lesson.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Choosing a Class
steps.body:
Each hero can learn one class at a time — assign a book to change their fighting style, abilities, and stat growth. Classes from new regions unlock as you progress.

Higher training hall tiers also grant bonus experience to all your heroes across every region. Knowledge compounds.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Training Slots
steps.body:
Benched heroes don't have to sit idle. Assign them to a training slot and they'll earn passive experience while your party runs dungeons — no risk required.

Slot capacity and XP rate improve with facility tier. At Tier 1 you get 2 slots at 50% XP rate; at Tier 4, 4 slots at 75%. A hero in training can't join the party until you remove them.
